description: Read an edit outcome. Only done means After Effects reported verified readback; a done edit carries snapshot.fresh (true once the shared composition shows the edit; it waits a few seconds for it) and snapshot.message; then read the project again (when fresh is false, follow snapshot.message), and never reuse layer keys from before the edit. A running render reports its frame count in message; a finished render carries result.assetId, the movie in the Switch library. First call aftereffects_list_connections to get the deviceId of your connected After Effects panel.

deviceId.description: The id of your connected After Effects panel, from aftereffects_list_connections.
